reviews.t: The pain au chocolat amandes was delicious!!! I also had the chausson aux pommes which was alright. Their baguette was also very good and crunchy.
Les proprios sont adorables, les employé.e.s aussi. On est toujours accueillis avec le sourire, le pain et les viennoiseries sont délicieuses et généreuses.

Il miglior pain aux raisins, pain au chocolat, croissant aux amandes e pain suisse artigianali mangiati nella zona. Complimenti! La proprietaria è una persona molto gentile e sorridente. 🙂 peccato avere scoperto questa Boulangerie solo due giorni prima di ripartire
Beaucoup de choix, prix abordables mais viennoiseries pas terribles, je vous recommande plutôt le salé
